name: readability
description: Score English prose and identify difficult words and sentences locally.
long_description: Adds an analyze_readability tool to Claude Desktop. Returns Flesch Reading Ease (0-100), MTLD, TTR, sentence and word stats, sample-size warnings, difficult-word hints, and complex sentence hints. The analyzer runs locally and makes no network requests.

tools.name: analyze_readability
tools.description: Analyze English prose for Flesch Reading Ease, sample-size warnings, difficult words, and complex sentence hints.
